sentences.en: Did you break the window on purpose or by accident?
sentences.zh: 你是故意打破窗户的吗？还是意外弄坏的？

sentences.en: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
sentences.zh: 我们必须对这次事故进行仔细分析。

sentences.en: Harry was late for class yesterday because of his accident.
sentences.zh: 哈里昨天因为出了状况迟到了上课。
